words.enDefinition: Group of screen projects a production organization is currently developing

examples.en: The fictional studio adds a short series to its development slate this term.
examples.zh: 虚构工作室本学期将一部短剧加入「开发中项目清单」。

examples.en: We compared the projects on the development slate before reading their individual budgets.
examples.zh: 我们先比较「开发中项目清单」上的项目，再阅读各自的预算。

words.enDefinition: Reader's written summary and evaluation of a screenplay for development decisions

examples.en: Our tutor assigned script coverage for a sample screenplay about two student musicians.
examples.zh: 老师布置我们为一部关于两名学生乐手的示例剧本撰写「剧本评估报告」。

examples.en: We compared the script coverage with the script to see which concerns it emphasized.
examples.zh: 我们将「剧本评估报告」与剧本对照，查看它重点指出了哪些问题。

words.enDefinition: Prose account outlining a proposed film's story, main characters, and progression

examples.en: The screenplay treatment summarizes the main scenes before the writers draft the dialogue.
examples.zh: 编剧起草对白前，先用「剧本故事梗概」概述主要场景。

examples.en: We read the screenplay treatment to see how the two plotlines would connect.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「剧本故事梗概」，查看两条情节线会如何衔接。

words.enDefinition: Brief pitch that states a screen project's central premise or dramatic situation

examples.en: The student producer reads the logline before showing the full project outline.
examples.zh: 学生制片人先读「一句话剧情简介」，再展示完整项目提纲。

examples.en: We revised the logline when the main character's goal became clearer.
examples.zh: 主要角色的目标更清楚之后，我们修改了「一句话剧情简介」。

words.enDefinition: Reference document describing a series' world, characters, and approach across episodes

examples.en: The writers consult the series bible when outlining a story for another episode.
examples.zh: 编剧构思另一集的故事时，查阅了「剧集设定手册」。

examples.en: Our group included episode ideas and recurring settings in the series bible.
examples.zh: 我们组把每集的构思和反复出现的场景写进了「剧集设定手册」。

words.enDefinition: Short film made to demonstrate the potential of a proposed screen project

examples.en: The students made a proof-of-concept short to show how the imagined world might look.
examples.zh: 学生制作了「概念验证短片」，展示构想中的世界会是什么样。

examples.en: The proof-of-concept short helped classmates understand the tone of the proposed feature.
examples.zh: 「概念验证短片」帮助同学理解了拟拍长片的基调。

words.enDefinition: Script for a sample episode designed to establish a proposed series

examples.en: The pilot script introduces the main setting and two recurring characters in the series.
examples.zh: 「试播集剧本」介绍了该剧的主要场景和两个常驻角色。

examples.en: Our group read the pilot script aloud before discussing the proposed first season.
examples.zh: 我们组先朗读「试播集剧本」，再讨论拟制作的第一季。

words.enDefinition: Episode of an existing series designed to introduce a potential spinoff

examples.en: The fictional series introduces another campus team in a backdoor pilot for a spinoff.
examples.zh: 虚构剧集用一集「嵌入式试播集」为衍生剧介绍另一支校园球队。

examples.en: We identified the backdoor pilot because its new characters could carry a separate series.
examples.zh: 几个新角色能够撑起一部独立剧集，我们由此认出了「嵌入式试播集」。

words.enDefinition: Commission authorizing production of a specified run of episodes for a series

examples.en: The fictional broadcaster issues a series order after the commissioner reviews a sample episode.
examples.zh: 虚构播出机构的委制负责人看完样片后，机构发出了「剧集制作订单」。

examples.en: We noted how many episodes the series order covered in the fictional memo.
examples.zh: 我们记下了虚构备忘录中的「剧集制作订单」包含多少集。

words.enDefinition: Commission authorizing production of a sample episode for a proposed series

examples.en: The fictional network issues a pilot order before deciding whether to commission a series.
examples.zh: 虚构电视网先下达「试播集制作订单」，再决定是否委托制作整部剧。

examples.en: Our worksheet distinguishes the pilot order from a commitment to make a season.
examples.zh: 我们的习题把「试播集制作订单」和承诺制作整季区分开来。

words.enDefinition: UK broadcast role selecting and commissioning projects for a schedule or service

examples.en: The UK broadcaster's commissioning editor considers which proposals fit the planned schedule.
examples.zh: 英国播出机构的「节目委制编辑」考量哪些提案符合拟定排期。

examples.en: We met with a tutor playing the commissioning editor in our pitch exercise.
examples.zh: 在提案练习中，我们与扮演「节目委制编辑」的老师见了面。

words.enDefinition: Producer who develops screen ideas and helps shape projects before production

examples.en: The development producer helps the student team turn a concept into a pitch.
examples.zh: 「开发制片人」帮助学生团队把构想整理成可提报的方案。

examples.en: Our case follows a development producer who reshapes the proposed series with the writers.
examples.zh: 案例讲的是一位「开发制片人」与编剧一起调整拟制作剧集的过程。

collocations: pitch an idea to a development producer

words.enDefinition: Development professional who works with writers to improve scripts and maintain coherence

examples.en: The script editor flags a scene that conflicts with an earlier draft decision.
examples.zh: 「剧本编辑」指出一场戏与前一稿确立的情节有冲突。

examples.en: We discussed the script editor notes before rewriting the ending of our scene.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论了「剧本编辑」的意见，再改写那场戏的结尾。

words.enDefinition: Writer-producer overseeing a series' creative direction and day-to-day production decisions

examples.en: The showrunner in the mock production balances writing deadlines and filming needs.
examples.zh: 模拟制作中的「剧集总负责人」协调编剧期限与拍摄需求。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why the showrunner approves changes that affect several episodes.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么会影响多集的改动要由「剧集总负责人」批准。

words.enDefinition: Team or working setting where writers develop a television series collaboratively

examples.en: A mock writers' room outlined three episode ideas during the afternoon workshop.
examples.zh: 模拟「编剧室」在下午的工作坊中拟出了三集剧情构思。

examples.en: We divided tasks within the writers' room after agreeing on the season arc.
examples.zh: 我们就全季的故事走向达成一致后，在「编剧室」里分了工。

words.enDefinition: Scene-by-scene inventory of cast, locations, props, and other requirements for filming

examples.en: The script breakdown lists performers, locations, and props for each scene in the film.
examples.zh: 「剧本拆解清单」列出了影片每场戏的演员、场地和道具。

examples.en: We used the script breakdown to identify scenes that shared a filming location.
examples.zh: 我们用「剧本拆解清单」找出共用同一拍摄地点的几场戏。

words.enDefinition: Production-ready screenplay formatted as a working reference for filming

examples.en: The shooting script uses stable scene numbers so different departments can coordinate.
examples.zh: 「拍摄剧本」采用固定的场次编号，方便不同部门协调工作。

examples.en: We checked the shooting script after the location change affected two planned scenes.
examples.zh: 更换地点影响原定两场戏之后，我们查阅了「拍摄剧本」。

words.enDefinition: Replacement pages documenting changes to a script during an active production

examples.en: The coordinator distributes script revision pages after the location change affects the evening scene.
examples.zh: 拍摄地点变更影响晚间场次后，协调员发放了「剧本修订页」。

examples.en: We checked the date on the script revision pages before updating our scene notes.
examples.zh: 更新场次笔记之前，我们核对了「剧本修订页」上的日期。

words.enDefinition: Authorize a screen project to proceed into production

examples.en: The fictional studio may greenlight the series after reviewing the revised plan.
examples.zh: 虚构工作室审阅修订方案后，可能会「批准投拍」这部剧。

examples.en: Our case asks what evidence the panel considered before voting to greenlight production.
examples.zh: 案例问，评审小组在表决是否「批准投拍」之前考虑了哪些证据。

words.enDefinition: Phase in which a screen project is planned and prepared before filming

examples.en: The group booked rehearsal space and checked locations during pre-production for the film.
examples.zh: 小组在影片「拍摄前筹备」阶段预订了排练场地，并查看拍摄地点。

examples.en: Our schedule separates pre-production from the weeks assigned to actual filming.
examples.zh: 我们把「拍摄前筹备」和实际拍摄所占的几周分开排期。

words.enDefinition: Main period in which the planned scenes for a screen project are filmed

examples.en: The fictional feature begins principal photography after the studio finishes building its main set.
examples.zh: 虚构长片将在摄影棚完成主要布景搭建后开始「主体拍摄」。

examples.en: We marked principal photography separately from the extra filming arranged after the shoot.
examples.zh: 我们把「主体拍摄」和之后另行安排的补拍分开标注。

words.enDefinition: US production role overseeing a filming unit's budget, scheduling, and off-set logistics

examples.en: The US class example assigns the unit production manager responsibility for the crew's travel arrangements.
examples.zh: 美国课堂案例将摄制组的出行安排交给「摄制组制片主任」。

examples.en: We checked which decisions the unit production manager made about the mock unit's daily budget.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「摄制组制片主任」对模拟摄制组的每日预算作了哪些决定。

collocations: work with a unit production manager
duties of a unit production manager

words.enDefinition: Producer responsible for managing a production's practical operations, schedule, and budget

examples.en: The line producer updates the schedule after the main location becomes unavailable.
examples.zh: 主要拍摄场地无法使用后，「执行制片人」更新了日程。

examples.en: Our exercise asks the line producer to explain why two filming days cost more.
examples.zh: 练习请「执行制片人」解释为什么其中两个拍摄日的开支较高。

words.enDefinition: Crew member coordinating production office paperwork, communications, and practical arrangements

examples.en: The production coordinator sends the student crew a reminder about the new meeting point.
examples.zh: 「制片协调员」向学生摄制组发出提醒，告知新的集合地点。

examples.en: We asked the production coordinator where to find the latest schedule for rehearsals.
examples.zh: 我们问「制片协调员」在哪里能找到最新的排练日程。

words.enDefinition: Head of the department shaping the visual world of a screen production

examples.en: The production designer presents sketches of the fictional library before the set is built.
examples.zh: 图书馆布景搭建前，「影视美术指导」展示了场景草图。

examples.en: Our team asked the production designer how the two locations might share a palette.
examples.zh: 我们组问「影视美术指导」，怎样让两个地点采用相同的配色。

words.enDefinition: UK industry term for visiting a potential location to assess filming suitability

examples.en: In the UK example, the crew schedules a location recce before choosing a library.
examples.zh: 在英国案例中，摄制组在选定图书馆前安排了「拍摄场地勘查」。

examples.en: We used notes from the location recce to discuss background noise and available space.
examples.zh: 我们用「拍摄场地勘查」记录讨论该地背景噪声与可用空间。

words.enDefinition: Schedule board using movable strips to organize scenes and shooting days

examples.en: The stripboard makes it easy to group scenes that share a location.
examples.zh: 「场次条形排期表」方便将使用同一拍摄地点的场次排在一起。

examples.en: We rearranged the stripboard when two performers became unavailable that afternoon.
examples.zh: 两位演员当天午后无法出席，我们便调整了「场次条形排期表」。

words.enDefinition: Daily production document giving filming details and arrival times for cast and crew

examples.en: The call sheet lists the morning location and the time the crew should arrive.
examples.zh: 「拍摄日通告单」列出了上午的拍摄地点和摄制组到场时间。

examples.en: We checked the call sheet again after the rehearsal changed to a different room.
examples.zh: 排练改到另一个房间后，我们再次核对了「拍摄日通告单」。

words.enDefinition: Production record summarizing work completed and relevant activity on a shooting day

examples.en: The daily production report notes that the crew completed one scene and postponed another.
examples.zh: 「每日拍摄报告」记录摄制组完成了一场戏，推迟了另一场。

examples.en: We used the daily production report to compare planned work with what actually happened.
examples.zh: 我们用「每日拍摄报告」对比计划内的工作和实际完成的情况。

words.enDefinition: US production schedule showing each cast member's work status across shooting days

examples.en: The day out of days shows when each performer starts, works, and finishes the shoot.
examples.zh: 「演员按日工作表」显示各位演员何时开始、工作和结束拍摄。

examples.en: We checked the day out of days to see which actor was free on Friday.
examples.zh: 我们查看「演员按日工作表」，了解哪位演员周五有空。

collocations: prepare a day out of days
cast listed on the day out of days

words.enDefinition: Screen-budget category for key creative personnel, development, and certain underlying rights

examples.en: The sample film budget puts the writer's fee among the above-the-line costs.
examples.zh: 影片预算示例把编剧酬金归入「主创与项目开发成本」。

examples.en: We compared above-the-line costs for projects with different lead cast and development needs.
examples.zh: 我们比较了主演阵容和开发需求不同的几个项目的「主创与项目开发成本」。

words.enDefinition: Screen-budget category for practical production and post-production expenses outside key creative costs

examples.en: The fictional budget lists equipment hire and set construction among below-the-line costs.
examples.zh: 虚构预算将设备租赁和布景搭建列入「拍摄与后期执行成本」。

examples.en: We discussed which editing expenses appeared under below-the-line costs in the sample budget.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了预算示例中哪些剪辑开支列在「拍摄与后期执行成本」之下。

words.enDefinition: Crew leader coordinating filming logistics and the shooting schedule on set

examples.en: The first assistant director reorganizes the morning schedule when one performer arrives late.
examples.zh: 一名演员迟到后，「第一副导演」重新安排了上午的拍摄日程。

examples.en: We asked the first assistant director when our student crew would move to the next set.
examples.zh: 我们问「第一副导演」，学生摄制组几时转到下一处布景。

collocations: work with the first assistant director

words.enDefinition: Separate crew filming assigned material alongside or apart from the main unit

examples.en: The second unit films exterior details while the main crew works indoors.
examples.zh: 主要摄制组在室内工作时，「第二摄制组」负责拍外景细节。

examples.en: We checked which landscape shots were assigned to the second unit in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核对了练习中哪些风景镜头分给了「第二摄制组」。

collocations: assign shots to the second unit

words.enDefinition: On-set crew member tracking continuity, takes, and changes for the edit

examples.en: The script supervisor records which version of the line appears in each take.
examples.zh: 「影视场记」记录每条素材中说的是哪个版本的台词。

examples.en: We checked with the script supervisor before repeating the action from another angle.
examples.zh: 我们先和「影视场记」核对，再换一个角度重演该动作。

words.enDefinition: Crew leader shaping a production's visual photography with the director

examples.en: The director of photography and director agree on a visual look for the library scene.
examples.zh: 「摄影指导」与导演就图书馆场景的画面风格达成一致。

examples.en: We asked the director of photography how the two interiors would look visually distinct.
examples.zh: 我们问「摄影指导」，两个室内场景怎样在视觉上加以区分。

words.enDefinition: Camera assistant responsible for maintaining or changing focus during a take

examples.en: The focus puller keeps the actor sharp as she moves across the frame.
examples.zh: 演员横穿画面时，「跟焦员」让她始终保持清晰。

examples.en: We asked the focus puller to review two takes with different focus transitions.
examples.zh: 我们请「跟焦员」查看两条焦点转换不同的素材。

words.enDefinition: On-set camera specialist supporting image quality and the digital capture workflow

examples.en: The digital imaging technician checks that the reference look is applied consistently across both cameras.
examples.zh: 「数字影像技师」检查两台摄像机是否统一使用同一种参考画面基调。

examples.en: Our tutor showed where the digital imaging technician fits in the on-set image workflow.
examples.zh: 老师展示了「数字影像技师」在现场影像工作流程中所处的环节。

collocations: work with a digital imaging technician
duties of a digital imaging technician

words.enDefinition: Head of the on-set lighting crew working with the cinematographer

examples.en: The gaffer discusses the classroom scene's lighting with the director of photography.
examples.zh: 「灯光组长」与摄影指导讨论教室场景的照明。

examples.en: We asked the gaffer which setup the crew would review after lunch.
examples.zh: 我们问「灯光组长」，摄制组午饭后会检查哪套布置。

words.enDefinition: Head of the crew responsible for physical camera support and related rigging

examples.en: The director discusses a planned camera move with the key grip during rehearsal.
examples.zh: 导演在排练时与「器械组长」讨论计划中的运镜。

examples.en: We identified the key grip on the chart of the camera support crew.
examples.zh: 我们在摄影器械人员名单上辨认出了「器械组长」。

words.enDefinition: Crew member overseeing the recording of dialogue and other sound during filming

examples.en: The production sound mixer hears a chair scrape just before the actor's line.
examples.zh: 「现场录音师」在演员说台词前听到了椅子的刮擦声。

examples.en: Our crew asked the production sound mixer which take had the clearest dialogue.
examples.zh: 我们摄制组问「现场录音师」，哪一条里的对白最清楚。

collocations: work with the production sound mixer
notes from the production sound mixer

words.enDefinition: Sound crew member positioning a boom microphone to capture on-set audio

examples.en: The boom operator follows the two speakers while staying outside the camera frame.
examples.zh: 「吊杆话筒操作员」跟随两位说话者，同时避开摄像机画面。

examples.en: We rehearsed the movement once so the boom operator could check the framing.
examples.zh: 我们排练了一遍走位，让「吊杆话筒操作员」核对取景范围。

words.enDefinition: Crew member overseeing furnishings and decorative objects that dress a set

examples.en: The set decorator selects chairs and lamps for the fictional reading room.
examples.zh: 「布景陈设师」为虚构阅览室挑选椅子和灯具。

examples.en: We showed the set decorator the reference photographs for our student set.
examples.zh: 我们给「布景陈设师」看了学生剧组布景的参考照片。

words.enDefinition: Art department worker who sources and arranges purchases or rentals for sets

examples.en: The production buyer arranges a rental for the lamps chosen by the set decorator.
examples.zh: 「影视道具采购员」为布景陈设师选定的灯具安排租赁。

examples.en: We asked the production buyer which furnishings could arrive before the student shoot.
examples.zh: 我们问「影视道具采购员」，哪些陈设能在学生影片开拍前送到。

words.enDefinition: Production record identifying recorded clips or rolls and relevant camera details

examples.en: The camera report records which clip numbers belong to the morning setup.
examples.zh: 「摄影记录表」记录了上午那组拍摄设置对应的素材编号。

examples.en: We checked the camera report before matching footage from the two cameras.
examples.zh: 我们在匹配两台摄像机的素材之前先查看了「摄影记录表」。

words.enDefinition: Planning camera positions and movement in relation to performers and space

examples.en: The group reviews camera blocking before filming the conversation in the narrow corridor.
examples.zh: 小组在狭窄走廊拍摄对话之前，先检查「机位调度」。

examples.en: We changed the camera blocking after rehearsing where the two actors would stand.
examples.zh: 排练两位演员的站位之后，我们调整了「机位调度」。

words.enDefinition: Variety of shots recorded to provide editing choices for a scene

examples.en: The director reviews shot coverage before leaving the location used for the conversation.
examples.zh: 导演在离开对话场景的拍摄地之前查看了「场景镜头覆盖」情况。

examples.en: We compared the planned shot coverage with the angles available in the edit.
examples.zh: 我们将计划中的「场景镜头覆盖」与剪辑时实际可用的角度作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Shot covering an entire scene or action as a continuous overview

examples.en: The master shot shows both actors throughout the entire exchange at the counter.
examples.zh: 「主镜头」拍下柜台前两位演员进行完整对话的过程。

examples.en: We returned to the master shot when the edit needed to show their positions.
examples.zh: 剪辑需要交代两人所处位置时，我们回到了「主镜头」。

collocations: establish the scene with a master shot

words.enDefinition: Shot isolating a detail within the main action of a scene

examples.en: The editor adds an insert shot of the note lying beside the notebook.
examples.zh: 剪辑师加入一个「细节插入镜头」，拍的是放在笔记本旁的便条。

examples.en: We discussed what information the insert shot adds to the exchange at the counter.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了那个「细节插入镜头」给柜台前的对话补充了什么信息。

collocations: close framing for an insert shot

words.enDefinition: Shot temporarily shifting attention away from the scene's main action

examples.en: The class film uses a cutaway shot of the library clock during the conversation.
examples.zh: 课堂影片在对话中切到图书馆的钟，使用了一个「切离镜头」。

examples.en: We reviewed where the cutaway shot interrupts the scene before returning to the speakers.
examples.zh: 我们查看「切离镜头」在画面回到说话者之前从哪处切离当前场景。

words.enDefinition: Shot framing a subject with another person's shoulder in the foreground

examples.en: The over-the-shoulder shot frames the speaker behind the listener's shoulder in the foreground.
examples.zh: 「过肩镜头」将听者的肩膀放在前景，拍摄肩后说话的人。

examples.en: We tried an over-the-shoulder shot to show the exchange without losing its spatial context.
examples.zh: 我们试拍了一个「过肩镜头」，以保留两人对话时的空间关系。

words.enDefinition: Edit following a character's gaze with a shot of what they see

examples.en: The eyeline match cuts from the student's glance to a notebook across the room.
examples.zh: 「视线匹配」剪辑先拍学生望过去，再切到房间另一头的笔记本。

examples.en: We checked the eyeline match before finalizing the cut between the two shots.
examples.zh: 我们在确定两个镜头之间的剪接之前检查了「视线匹配」。

words.enDefinition: Ambient sound recorded in a location without deliberate speech or action

examples.en: The sound crew records room tone after the actors finish the reading room scene.
examples.zh: 演员拍完阅览室场景后，录音组录下了「室内环境底声」。

examples.en: We used room tone to smooth the transition between two lines of dialogue.
examples.zh: 我们用「室内环境底声」让两句对白之间的过渡更自然。

words.enDefinition: Sound recorded separately from synchronized picture for later use in editing

examples.en: The crew records a wild track of footsteps after the camera stops rolling.
examples.zh: 摄像机停止拍摄后，摄制组另录了一条脚步声「非同步现场音轨」。

examples.en: We checked whether the wild track matched the atmosphere of the finished scene.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「非同步现场音轨」是否贴合成片场景的氛围。

collocations: sound captured as a wild track

words.enDefinition: On-set notes tracking details that should match across takes and setups

examples.en: The continuity notes record which hand the actor used to open the notebook.
examples.zh: 「连贯性记录」注明演员用哪只手打开笔记本。

examples.en: We consulted the continuity notes before shooting the same exchange from another angle.
examples.zh: 我们先查阅「连贯性记录」，再从另一角度拍同一段对话。

words.enDefinition: Recently recorded footage prepared for review during or shortly after filming

examples.en: The editor reviews the rushes before assembling the scene for the tutorial.
examples.zh: 剪辑师先查看「当日拍摄素材」，再为辅导课把场景剪接起来。

examples.en: We noticed a change in lighting while comparing two takes from the rushes.
examples.zh: 我们对照两条「当日拍摄素材」时注意到光线变了。

words.enDefinition: Lightweight copies of source files used to make editing more manageable

examples.en: The student editor uses proxy media because the source files are too large.
examples.zh: 源文件太大，学生剪辑师改用「剪辑代理素材」工作。

examples.en: We checked that the proxy media matched the timing of the original clips.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「剪辑代理素材」是否与原始片段保持相同时间对应关系。

words.enDefinition: Creative editing stage focused on selecting and assembling picture and sound

examples.en: The offline edit focuses on the timing of the scenes and the performances.
examples.zh: 「离线剪辑」着重处理场景的节奏与演员的表演。

examples.en: We used smaller files for the offline edit before preparing the images for delivery.
examples.zh: 在为画面交付做准备前，我们用较小的文件完成「离线剪辑」。

words.enDefinition: Finishing stage preparing an edited sequence at the required technical quality

examples.en: The online edit replaces the smaller versions with the full-quality images for delivery.
examples.zh: 「在线精编」用完整画质的画面替换较小的版本，以便交付。

examples.en: We scheduled the online edit after the class agreed on the final scene order.
examples.zh: 课堂小组确定最终场次顺序后，我们安排了「在线精编」。

words.enDefinition: Early edit assembling filmed material into an initial sequence for review

examples.en: The assembly cut lets the group see the scenes together for the first time.
examples.zh: 「组接版」让小组成员第一次看到各场戏连在一起的样子。

examples.en: We watched the assembly cut before deciding where the student film could be shorter.
examples.zh: 我们先看了「组接版」，再决定学生影片哪些地方还可以缩短。

words.enDefinition: Early edited version showing the developing structure before detailed refinement

examples.en: The rough cut gives our classmates enough material to comment on the story.
examples.zh: 「粗剪版」的内容已经足够让同学对故事提出意见。

examples.en: We compared the rough cut with the revised version after making the suggested changes.
examples.zh: 按照建议修改后，我们对比了「粗剪版」和修改后的版本。

words.enDefinition: Refined edit with carefully adjusted timing and transitions before picture approval

examples.en: The fine cut tightens two pauses that felt too long in the earlier version.
examples.zh: 「精剪版」缩短了早先版本里显得太长的两处停顿。

examples.en: We screened the fine cut before deciding that no further picture changes were needed.
examples.zh: 我们放映了「精剪版」，之后确定画面无需再改动。

words.enDefinition: Milestone when shot choices and timings are approved and stop changing

examples.en: The group reaches picture lock before finishing the final sound and subtitle timing.
examples.zh: 小组先完成「画面锁定」，再定稿混音和字幕的时间点。

examples.en: We confirmed picture lock so the sound editor could work against consistent timings.
examples.zh: 我们确认已完成「画面锁定」，让声音剪辑师能按稳定的时间点工作。

words.enDefinition: Rebuilding an approved edit using corresponding full-quality source material

examples.en: During the picture conform, the finishing editor reconnects shots to their source files.
examples.zh: 做「画面套底」时，后期精编师将镜头重新连接到源文件。

examples.en: We checked one missing shot during the picture conform for the student film.
examples.zh: 给学生影片做「画面套底」时，我们核对了一个缺失的镜头。

words.enDefinition: Adjusting picture color and contrast to create a coherent visual look

examples.en: The student team uses colour grading to give the two locations distinct looks.
examples.zh: 学生团队用「画面调色」让两个拍摄地点呈现不同画面风格。

examples.en: We reviewed the colour grading on a larger monitor before exporting the final version.
examples.zh: 导出最终版本前，我们在更大的屏幕上检查了「画面调色」效果。

words.enDefinition: Meeting to identify where music or sound should enter or change

examples.en: The composer joins the spotting session to discuss where the music should begin.
examples.zh: 作曲人参加「声音点位讨论会」，商量音乐应该从哪里开始。

examples.en: We noted two silent moments during the spotting session for the short film.
examples.zh: 我们在短片的「声音点位讨论会」上记录了两处静默时刻。

words.enDefinition: Post-production rerecording of dialogue to synchronize with an existing picture

examples.en: The student film uses automated dialogue replacement for a line buried under background noise.
examples.zh: 学生影片用「对白补录」重录一句被背景噪声盖住的台词。

examples.en: We compared the timing before and after automated dialogue replacement in the final scene.
examples.zh: 我们比较了最后一场戏「对白补录」前后台词的时间点。

words.enDefinition: Sound effects performed and recorded to match actions shown on screen

examples.en: The sound team adds Foley for the notebook sliding across the table.
examples.zh: 声音团队为笔记本滑过桌面添加了「拟音」。

examples.en: We checked how well the Foley matched the actor's movements in the edit.
examples.zh: 我们检查了剪辑中「拟音」与演员动作是否贴合。

words.enDefinition: Post-production specialist combining dialogue, music, and effects into the final mix

examples.en: The re-recording mixer balances the music with the actors' dialogue in the scene.
examples.zh: 「后期混音师」平衡了该场戏中音乐与演员对白的音量。

examples.en: We asked the re-recording mixer to review two versions of the closing sequence.
examples.zh: 我们请「后期混音师」检查收尾段落的两个版本。

words.enDefinition: Separate audio submix containing the dialogue components of a larger soundtrack

examples.en: The editor checks the dialogue stem before combining it with the other audio stems.
examples.zh: 剪辑师在合并其他声音分轨之前，先检查了「对白分轨」。

examples.en: We compared the dialogue stem with the full mix to isolate the dialogue.
examples.zh: 我们对照「对白分轨」和全混音，以便单独听取对白。

words.enDefinition: Audio track containing music and effects for use with replacement dialogue

examples.en: The localization team needs the music and effects track to preserve the background sound during dubbing.
examples.zh: 本地化团队需要「音乐音效轨」，以便配音时保留原有背景声音。

examples.en: We listed the music and effects track separately from the original language dialogue in the delivery plan.
examples.zh: 我们在交付方案中将「音乐音效轨」与原声对白分别列出。

collocations: deliver a music and effects track
check the music and effects track
prepare a music and effects track

words.enDefinition: Master video version without selected on-screen text for creating localized versions

examples.en: The project needs a textless master so each distributor can add translated titles.
examples.zh: 该项目需要一份「无字母版」，让各发行商可以加上译制片名。

examples.en: We checked the textless master to make sure it omitted the original location captions.
examples.zh: 我们检查「无字母版」，确认它删去了原版标明地点的字幕。

words.enDefinition: Standardized collection of digital files prepared for compatible cinema projection systems

examples.en: The venue asks for a digital cinema package to screen the student film.
examples.zh: 放映场地要求提供一套「数字影院放映包」来放映学生影片。

examples.en: We checked whether the digital cinema package included the correct version of the subtitles.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「数字影院放映包」是否包含正确版本的字幕。

words.enDefinition: Approved final programme version prepared to a broadcaster's technical specifications

examples.en: The producer checks the broadcast master against the broadcaster's technical requirements for sound.
examples.zh: 制片人依据播出机构的声音技术要求检查「播出交付母版」。

examples.en: We labeled the broadcast master separately from the smaller file used for feedback.
examples.zh: 我们把「播出交付母版」和征集反馈时使用的小文件分开标注。

words.enDefinition: Viewing copy submitted for a festival's selection process rather than public projection

examples.en: Our group uploaded a festival screener for the fictional student festival selection panel.
examples.zh: 我们组为虚构学生电影节的选片小组上传了「电影节评审看片版」。

examples.en: We distinguished the festival screener from the package prepared for the actual screening.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「电影节评审看片版」与为正式放映准备的放映包。

words.enDefinition: File containing display text and its timing instructions for audiovisual playback

examples.en: The timed text file tells the playback system when each subtitle should appear.
examples.zh: 「时码字幕文件」告诉播放系统每条字幕应在什么时候出现。

examples.en: We checked that the timed text file matched the final version of the picture.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「时码字幕文件」是否与最终版画面匹配。

words.enDefinition: Setting the time when each subtitle begins and ends on screen

examples.en: The final edit is ready, so the team can start subtitle spotting now.
examples.zh: 最终剪辑已准备好，团队现在可以开始「字幕时间轴定位」。

examples.en: We reviewed subtitle spotting for lines spoken across a change of shot.
examples.zh: 我们检查了跨镜头切换时说出的台词的「字幕时间轴定位」。

words.enDefinition: Systematic review of delivery material for technical problems against specified requirements

examples.en: The quality-control pass flags a subtitle that remains visible beyond the final shot.
examples.zh: 「一轮技术质检」发现有一条字幕在最后一个镜头结束后仍显示。

examples.en: We scheduled a quality-control pass after exporting the file for our mock broadcaster.
examples.zh: 我们为模拟播出机构导出文件后安排了「一轮技术质检」。

words.enDefinition: Required technical characteristics for supplied screen media files and related material

examples.en: The fictional distributor's delivery specification lists file formats and required audio tracks.
examples.zh: 虚构发行商的「交付技术规范」列出了文件格式和必需音轨。

examples.en: We checked the delivery specification before choosing a file format for the master.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「交付技术规范」，再为母版选择文件格式。

words.enDefinition: Documentation tracing how the necessary rights in a production were acquired

examples.en: The course packet uses a sample chain of title to trace the adaptation rights.
examples.zh: 课程资料用一份示例「权利归属文件链」追溯改编权。

examples.en: We reviewed the chain of title separately from the delivery checklist in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们将「权利归属文件链」与交付清单分开审阅。

words.enDefinition: Rights in preexisting material on which a new screen project is based

examples.en: The fictional budget lists payments for underlying rights in the source novel.
examples.zh: 虚构预算列出了购买原著小说「原始素材权利」的支出。

examples.en: We discussed underlying rights before reading the mock deal for the finished film.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论「原始素材权利」，再阅读成片的模拟交易协议。

words.enDefinition: Rights to adapt an existing work for a film or television production

examples.en: The fictional producer seeks screen rights to adapt the novel for television.
examples.zh: 虚构制片人想取得「影视改编权」，把小说改编成电视剧。

examples.en: We checked who held screen rights in the sample project rights summary.
examples.zh: 我们在项目权利摘要的示例中确认了谁持有「影视改编权」。

words.enDefinition: Obtaining permission to use specified music in a screen production

examples.en: The group lists music clearance as a separate task for its fictional short.
examples.zh: 小组把「音乐使用授权」列为虚构短片的一项单独工作。

examples.en: We distinguished music clearance from recording where a song appeared in the edit.
examples.zh: 我们把取得「音乐使用授权」和记录歌曲出现在剪辑的哪个位置区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Obtaining permission to include existing archival material in a new production

examples.en: The fictional documentary includes archive clearance for footage sourced from a local archive.
examples.zh: 虚构纪录片涉及当地档案馆影像的「档案素材使用授权」。

examples.en: We discussed archive clearance for a historical image used in the classroom edit.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了课堂剪辑所用一张历史图片的「档案素材使用授权」。

words.enDefinition: Record identifying music used in a production and details of each use

examples.en: The music cue sheet lists the track, its placement, and how long it plays.
examples.zh: 「音乐使用明细表」列出了曲目、出现位置和播放时长。

examples.en: We checked the music cue sheet after shortening the music under the final scene.
examples.zh: 缩短最后一场戏的配乐后，我们查看了「音乐使用明细表」。

words.enDefinition: Distribution permissions limited to specified geographical markets under an agreement

examples.en: The classroom agreement grants territorial rights for one region but excludes neighboring markets.
examples.zh: 课堂协议授予一个地区的「地域发行权」，不包括邻近市场。

examples.en: We marked which territorial rights the fictional distributor would receive on the map.
examples.zh: 我们在地图上标出了虚构发行商会获得的「地域发行权」范围。

words.enDefinition: Information stating when, where, and how a title may be offered

examples.en: The platform checks content avails before adding a title to its regional catalogue.
examples.zh: 平台在把一部作品加入地区片库之前查看「内容发行可用信息」。

examples.en: We compared the content avails for two territories with different release windows.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个发行窗口不同地区的「内容发行可用信息」。

words.enDefinition: Specified period during which a title is available through a distribution outlet

examples.en: The case assigns one release window to the cinema and another to streaming.
examples.zh: 案例为影院和流媒体分别安排了一个「发行窗口期」。

examples.en: We compared the dates for each release window on the fictional launch calendar.
examples.zh: 我们比较了虚构发行日历中各个「发行窗口期」的日期。

words.enDefinition: Period allocated to cinema exhibition within a title's broader release schedule

examples.en: The theatrical window in the example ends before the film arrives on streaming.
examples.zh: 示例中的「院线放映窗口期」在影片上线流媒体之前结束。

examples.en: We marked the theatrical window separately from planned home viewing in the timeline.
examples.zh: 我们在时间线上把「院线放映窗口期」和计划中的家庭观看时段分开标注。

words.enDefinition: Time during which specified distribution uses must wait under a rights arrangement

examples.en: The sample schedule shows a holdback period before the fictional platform can screen it.
examples.zh: 样例排期显示，虚构平台必须等过「发行暂缓期」才能上线影片。

examples.en: We distinguished the holdback period from the period when the film was available.
examples.zh: 我们把「发行暂缓期」与观众能够看到影片的时段区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Release making a film available on different platforms on the same date

examples.en: The case uses a day-and-date release for cinema showings and online rental.
examples.zh: 案例将影院放映与网上租看安排为「跨渠道同日发行」。

examples.en: We identified a day-and-date release by comparing the two dates in the release plan.
examples.zh: 我们对照发行方案里的两个日期，辨认出这是「跨渠道同日发行」。

collocations: compare a day-and-date release with separate windows

words.enDefinition: Initial cinema release in select markets followed by gradual expansion

examples.en: Our platform release scenario starts in a few cinemas before adding other cities.
examples.zh: 我们的「渐进式院线发行」情境从少数影院开始，之后扩展到其他城市。

examples.en: We compared a platform release with an opening that used every booked location.
examples.zh: 我们把「渐进式院线发行」与一开始就在所有预订场地放映的安排作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Circulation of films for screenings outside conventional commercial cinema exhibition

examples.en: The case uses non-theatrical distribution to reach clubs and educational venues across the region.
examples.zh: 案例通过「非院线发行」触达全地区的社团与教育场地。

examples.en: We discussed whether the museum screenings belonged to the non-theatrical distribution plan.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了博物馆放映是否属于「非院线发行」方案。

words.enDefinition: Permission to show a film in specified educational settings or programmes

examples.en: The fictional university discusses educational screening rights before arranging a course screening for students.
examples.zh: 虚构大学先讨论「教育放映权」，再为学生安排课程放映。

examples.en: We marked educational screening rights separately from commercial cinema exhibition in the sample agreement.
examples.zh: 我们在样例协议中把「教育放映权」与商业影院放映分开标出。

words.enDefinition: Industry event where buyers and sellers present and negotiate screen projects or rights

examples.en: The simulation sends the producer to a film market to meet potential distributors.
examples.zh: 模拟情境中，制片人到「电影交易市场」与可能合作的发行商见面。

examples.en: We distinguished trading activity at a film market from public festival screenings.
examples.zh: 我们把「电影交易市场」里的买卖活动与电影节的公开放映区分开来。

collocations: present a project at a film market

words.enDefinition: Representative marketing and licensing a film's distribution rights to potential buyers

examples.en: The film sales agent presents the fictional feature to distributors from several territories.
examples.zh: 「影片销售代理」向几个地区的发行商介绍这部虚构长片。

examples.en: We discussed what the film sales agent did before the distributors agreed to release it.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了发行商同意发行前，「影片销售代理」做了哪些事。

collocations: work with a film sales agent

words.enDefinition: Licensing a screen title's distribution rights separately for distinct geographical markets

examples.en: The workbook breaks territory sales into separate agreements for three geographical markets.
examples.zh: 练习册将「分地区版权销售」拆为对应三个地理市场的不同协议。

examples.en: We checked how territory sales contributed to the classroom production's projected revenue.
examples.zh: 我们查看「分地区版权销售」如何为课堂制作项目带来预计收入。

words.enDefinition: Agreement licensing distribution rights before a screen project is completed

examples.en: The fictional producer enters a pre-sale agreement before completing the feature film.
examples.zh: 虚构制片人在长片完成之前订立了「发行权预售协议」。

examples.en: We identified when the pre-sale agreement was signed on the production finance timeline.
examples.zh: 我们在制作融资时间线上确定了「发行权预售协议」的签署时间。

collocations: finance supported by a pre-sale agreement

words.enDefinition: Distribution deal covering all agreed exploitation media within the defined scope

examples.en: The mock all-rights deal covers cinema, home viewing, and television in one territory.
examples.zh: 模拟「全渠道权利交易」涵盖一个地区的影院、家庭观看和电视。

examples.en: We checked which territory the all-rights deal covered before comparing the two offers.
examples.zh: 我们在对比两项报价之前，先核对「全渠道权利交易」涵盖哪个地区。

words.enDefinition: Minimum amount a distributor promises in exchange for specified distribution rights

examples.en: The sample deal lists a minimum guarantee separately from possible later revenue shares.
examples.zh: 样例交易将「最低保底发行款」与之后可能分到的收入分开列出。

examples.en: We discussed how the minimum guarantee appeared in the fictional film's financing plan.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了虚构影片的融资方案如何列示「最低保底发行款」。

words.enDefinition: Amount paid or retained by a distributor for its distribution services

examples.en: The worksheet lists the distribution fee as a separate deduction from gross receipts.
examples.zh: 习题把「发行服务费」列为总收入中的单独扣除项。

examples.en: We compared the distribution fee across two sample agreements for the same film.
examples.zh: 我们对比同一部影片的两份样本协议中的「发行服务费」。

words.enDefinition: Costs incurred in preparing, marketing, and delivering a title to outlets

examples.en: The mock report lists artwork and file delivery among its distribution expenses.
examples.zh: 模拟报告把宣传图制作和文件交付列入「发行支出」。

examples.en: We distinguished distribution expenses from the fee retained by the distributor in the example.
examples.zh: 我们将「发行支出」与示例中发行商保留的服务费区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Document specifying the order in which parties recover amounts from receipts

examples.en: The recoupment schedule shows which costs are recovered before other participants receive payments.
examples.zh: 「回款分配顺序表」说明了哪些成本先收回，之后其他参与方才获得款项。

examples.en: We traced a sample payment through the recoupment schedule in the finance exercise.
examples.zh: 融资练习中，我们沿着「回款分配顺序表」追踪了一笔样例款项。

words.enDefinition: Return of previously granted rights to the original holder under stated conditions

examples.en: The mock deal includes rights reversion after the agreed license period ends.
examples.zh: 模拟协议规定，约定的许可期结束后发生「权利回归」。

examples.en: We identified which party received the rights again under the rights reversion clause.
examples.zh: 我们辨认出根据「权利回归」条款，权利重新归到哪一方。

words.enDefinition: US licensing of a programme's original run directly to individual stations

examples.en: The US example uses first-run syndication for a programme licensed to separate stations.
examples.zh: 美国案例对一档分别授权各地方台的节目采用了「首播分销」。

examples.en: We distinguished first-run syndication from selling repeats of a previously networked series.
examples.zh: 我们把「首播分销」与将原电视网剧集卖给其他台重播区分开来。

words.zhGloss: 系列作品打包发行协议
words.enDefinition: Agreement covering a production supplier's specified output over an agreed period
acceptedZhAnswers: 系列作品打包发行协议

examples.en: The fictional distributor signs an output deal covering several future films from one producer.
examples.zh: 虚构发行商签订了一项「系列作品打包发行协议」，涵盖同一制片人未来的几部影片。

examples.en: We compared the output deal with a contract limited to one completed film.
examples.zh: 我们将「系列作品打包发行协议」与仅涵盖一部成片的合同作了比较。

collocations: titles covered by an output deal

words.enDefinition: Agreement giving one party the first opportunity to consider specified new projects

examples.en: The mock studio has a first-look deal to consider the producer's next project.
examples.zh: 模拟工作室通过「项目优先审议协议」先审议制片人的下一个项目。

examples.en: We discussed what the first-look deal covered before comparing it with a purchase commitment.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论「项目优先审议协议」的覆盖范围，再把它与购买承诺作比较。

words.enDefinition: Television programming delivered in a scheduled sequence at set times

examples.en: The course contrasts linear television with a library of programmes viewers start themselves.
examples.zh: 课程将「线性电视」与由观众自行选择播放的节目库作了对照。

examples.en: Our chart places linear television on a timeline showing when each show starts.
examples.zh: 我们的图表将「线性电视」放在时间线上，标出各档节目的开始时间。

words.enDefinition: Broadcast television available without a subscription charge for the channel

examples.en: The sample rights table lists free-to-air television separately from subscription channels.
examples.zh: 示例权利表将「免费接收电视」与订阅频道分开列出。

examples.en: We compared free-to-air television with services for which the fictional audience pays a subscription.
examples.zh: 我们将「免费接收电视」与虚构受众需要付费订阅的服务作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Television channels or packages accessed through a paid service subscription

examples.en: The case assigns one window to pay television after the cinema run ends.
examples.zh: 案例在影院放映结束后给「付费电视」安排了一个发行窗口。

examples.en: We separated pay television from the free channels in the fictional service comparison.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构服务对比中，将「付费电视」与免费频道分开列出。

words.enDefinition: Defined portion of the broadcast day used for scheduling or audience analysis

examples.en: The sample schedule groups programmes by daypart instead of listing them alphabetically.
examples.zh: 样例排期按「日内播出时段」给节目分组，没有按字母顺序排列。

examples.en: We compared the channel's afternoon audience with that of a later daypart.
examples.zh: 我们将同一频道的下午受众与较晚「日内播出时段」的受众作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Programme scheduled immediately before another, potentially drawing viewers into the following show

examples.en: The scheduler chooses a programme lead-in that might bring viewers to the new drama.
examples.zh: 排期员选择了一档可能为新剧带来观众的「前导节目」。

examples.en: We reviewed the programme lead-in before explaining the audience pattern for the later show.
examples.zh: 解释后一档节目的受众分布之前，我们先查看其「前导节目」。

words.enDefinition: Scheduling the same programme at a consistent time on multiple consecutive days

examples.en: The channel uses stripped scheduling for the same series across the weekday timetable.
examples.zh: 这个频道在工作日时间表中为同一剧集采用「固定日播排期」。

examples.en: We distinguished stripped scheduling from a programme appearing only once each week.
examples.zh: 我们把「固定日播排期」与每周只播一次的节目安排区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Simultaneous transmission of the same programme on different channels or platforms

examples.en: The mock schedule lists a simulcast on television and the broadcaster's website.
examples.zh: 模拟排期列出电视和播出机构网站的「同步播出」。

examples.en: We distinguished a simulcast from a stream made available after the broadcast.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「同步播出」与电视播出后才提供的网络播放。

words.enDefinition: Watching a scheduled programme after its original broadcast time through later playback

examples.en: The table reports time-shifted viewing separately from watching the programme as it airs.
examples.zh: 表格把「时移观看」和节目播出时同步观看分开报告。

examples.en: We discussed whether watching a recording the next day counted as time-shifted viewing.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了次日观看一份录像是否算「时移观看」。

words.enDefinition: On-demand viewing of a programme recently made available after its scheduled broadcast

examples.en: The survey records catch-up viewing when viewers select the episode from the broadcaster's service.
examples.zh: 观众从播出机构的服务里选看该集时，调查将其记录为「节目回看」。

examples.en: We discussed catch-up viewing separately from watching the current broadcast as scheduled.
examples.zh: 我们将「节目回看」与按排期观看正在播出的节目分开讨论。

words.enDefinition: Next-day audience estimates incorporating live and eligible same-day playback in UK Barb reporting

examples.en: The Barb example includes same-day playback in the overnight ratings reported next morning.
examples.zh: Barb 示例把当天回放也计入第二天上午报告的「次日初步收视数据」。

examples.en: We compared the overnight ratings with the later totals for the fictional broadcast.
examples.zh: 我们将「次日初步收视数据」与该虚构节目之后的累计数据作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Audience estimates combining live viewing and eligible playback within a stated reporting window

examples.en: The Barb worksheet gives consolidated viewing for a stated period after the original transmission.
examples.zh: Barb 习题给出了首次播出后指定时段内的「合并收视数据」。

examples.en: We compared consolidated viewing with figures published the morning after the programme aired.
examples.zh: 我们把「合并收视数据」与节目播出次日上午发布的数值作了比较。

collocations: compare consolidated viewing with overnight figures

words.enDefinition: Proportion of all viewing in a defined period attributable to particular content

examples.en: The chart shows viewing share for two channels during the same evening period.
examples.zh: 图表显示两个频道在同一晚间时段的「收视份额」。

examples.en: We checked which viewing was included in the denominator for viewing share.
examples.zh: 我们检查了「收视份额」的分母中包括哪些观看行为。

words.enDefinition: Number or proportion of distinct viewers meeting a programme's stated viewing criterion

examples.en: The classroom table counts each eligible viewer only once when estimating programme reach.
examples.zh: 课堂表格在估计「节目收视触达」时，每位符合条件的观众只计一次。

examples.en: We checked the minimum viewing rule used for programme reach in the fictional report.
examples.zh: 我们查看虚构报告对「节目收视触达」采用了怎样的最低观看要求。

words.enDefinition: Average number of people viewing across the measured programme or time interval

examples.en: The sample chart lists the average audience alongside the number of distinct viewers.
examples.zh: 样本图表在独立观众数量旁列出了「平均收视人数」。

examples.en: We compared the average audience for two episodes with very different opening peaks.
examples.zh: 我们比较了开场收视峰值差别很大的两集的「平均收视人数」。

words.enDefinition: Selected group whose viewing is measured to estimate a broader audience

examples.en: The methodology section explains how the viewing panel represents a broader television audience.
examples.zh: 方法章节解释了「收视调查样本组」如何代表更广泛的电视受众。

examples.en: We distinguished the viewing panel from the full population in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图示中将「收视调查样本组」与总体区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Watching the same content together, typically on one shared screen

examples.en: The worksheet illustrates co-viewing when two roommates watch one programme on one screen.
examples.zh: 习题用两名室友在同一屏幕上观看同一节目的情形说明「共同收看」。

examples.en: We discussed why co-viewing can make audience size larger than device counts suggest.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么「共同收看」可能使观众人数多于设备数量所显示的规模。

words.enDefinition: Adjusting participants' contributions so aggregate panel estimates better reflect the target population

examples.en: The classroom report explains panel weighting before publishing estimates for the simulated audience.
examples.zh: 课堂报告先解释「样本组加权」，再公布模拟受众的估计值。

examples.en: Our group compared the aggregate figures before and after panel weighting in class.
examples.zh: 我们组在课堂上比较了「样本组加权」前后的汇总数据。

words.enDefinition: Amount of viewing expressed in minutes under a stated counting rule

examples.en: The dashboard uses viewing minutes to describe how long the group watched each series.
examples.zh: 仪表板用「观看分钟数」描述该组观看每部剧的时长。

examples.en: We compared viewing minutes without assuming both episodes had the same duration.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「观看分钟数」，没有假定两集的节目时长相同。

words.enDefinition: Viewing duration averaged per person or other defined unit over a period

examples.en: The sample report gives average viewing time per person for each fictional channel.
examples.zh: 示例报告给出了各虚构频道的人均「平均观看时长」。

examples.en: We checked the unit used to calculate average viewing time in the streaming dashboard.
examples.zh: 我们检查了流媒体仪表板计算「平均观看时长」所用的统计单位。

words.enDefinition: Extent to which viewers continue watching through points in a programme

examples.en: The sample graph shows viewer retention falling shortly before the credits begin.
examples.zh: 样本图表显示，「观众留存」在片尾字幕出现前不久开始下降。

examples.en: We used the viewer retention curve to identify where viewers stopped watching.
examples.zh: 我们用「观众留存」曲线辨认观众在哪个位置停止观看。

words.enDefinition: Share of eligible viewers or starts meeting an episode's completion criterion

examples.en: The fictional platform states its scoring rule before reporting the episode completion rate.
examples.zh: 虚构平台先说明统计规则，再报告「单集完播率」。

examples.en: We compared the episode completion rate with how many people began watching the episode.
examples.zh: 我们将「单集完播率」与开始观看该集的人数作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Loss of subscribers through cancellations or nonrenewals over a defined period

examples.en: The mock service reports subscriber churn separately from a decline in viewing minutes.
examples.zh: 模拟服务把「订阅用户流失」与观看分钟数减少分开报告。

examples.en: We compared subscriber churn before and after two fictional membership periods ended.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个虚构订阅周期结束前后的「订阅用户流失」情况。

words.enDefinition: Viewers watching the measured stream at the same point in time

examples.en: The live report plots concurrent viewers as the fictional event progresses through its schedule.
examples.zh: 直播报告按虚构活动的进行时序绘制「同时在线观众」人数。

examples.en: We distinguished concurrent viewers from everyone who watched at any point during the evening.
examples.zh: 我们将「同时在线观众」与当晚任意时刻看过节目的人区分开来。

words.enDefinition: On-demand access to a video catalogue through a paid subscription

examples.en: The case gives members unlimited access to a catalogue through subscription video on demand.
examples.zh: 案例通过「订阅式视频点播」向会员提供可不限次数观看的片库。

examples.en: We compared subscription video on demand with paying separately to rent a single title.
examples.zh: 我们将「订阅式视频点播」与另付费租看单部作品作了比较。

collocations: subscriber to subscription video on demand

words.enDefinition: On-demand viewing model charging separately to rent or purchase individual titles

examples.en: The plan uses transactional video on demand to make the film available for a separate rental charge.
examples.zh: 方案以「单片付费视频点播」模式提供影片，观看者需另付租看费。

examples.en: We compared transactional video on demand with an offer charging a monthly catalogue subscription.
examples.zh: 我们将「单片付费视频点播」和对整个片库按月收费的方案作了比较。

collocations: revenue from transactional video on demand

words.enDefinition: On-demand video viewing funded wholly or partly through advertisements

examples.en: The fictional platform offers advertising-supported video on demand for viewers who accept ads during playback.
examples.zh: 虚构平台向愿意在播放中看广告的观众提供「广告支持型视频点播」。

examples.en: We distinguished advertising-supported video on demand from ad-funded channels with a fixed programme schedule.
examples.zh: 我们把「广告支持型视频点播」与通过广告筹资的固定排期频道区分开来。

collocations: revenue from advertising-supported video on demand

words.enDefinition: On-demand video service provided by a television broadcaster for its content

examples.en: The UK example puts earlier episodes on broadcaster video on demand after scheduled transmission.
examples.zh: 英国案例在按排期播出之后，将前几集放到「广播机构视频点播」服务上。

examples.en: We compared the audience for one programme on broadcaster video on demand and linear television.
examples.zh: 我们比较了同一节目在「广播机构视频点播」和线性电视上的受众。

collocations: watch via broadcaster video on demand
measure broadcaster video on demand audiences

words.zhGloss: 免费广告支持流媒体电视
words.enDefinition: Free internet-delivered channels with scheduled programming financed through advertising
acceptedZhAnswers: 免费广告支持流媒体电视

examples.en: The sample platform offers free ad-supported streaming television with scheduled channels and no subscription payment.
examples.zh: 示例平台提供按照排期播出的频道，用户可以不付订阅费收看「免费广告支持流媒体电视」。

examples.en: We distinguished free ad-supported streaming television from services where every programme is selected on demand.
examples.zh: 我们把「免费广告支持流媒体电视」与每个节目都由用户自行点播的服务区分开来。

collocations: audience for free ad-supported streaming television
